title: Evolution strategies as a scalable alternative to reinforcement learning
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial

body:
We’ve discovered that evolution strategies (ES), an optimization technique that’s been known for decades, rivals the performance of standard reinforcement learning (RL) techniques on modern RL benchmarks (e.g. Atari/MuJoCo), while overcoming many of RL’s inconveniences.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/evolution-strategies).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
